Criterion: Verify that the probability of failure due to uncontained rotating parts damaging air vehicle safety of flight/critical safety items is acceptable. Standard: The severity of all hazards associated with uncontained failures are reduced to an acceptable level or have residual risk accepted in accordance with MIL-STD-882. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, inspection and review of documentation. Inspection of the safety analyses documentation verifies that hazards associated with uncontained failures are reduced to an acceptable level. Reference: MIL-STD-882
